title: kiln.yaml
description: One kiln run: what to run, where, and its hard caps. Unknown fields are rejected.

name.description: Run name prefix. Each run gets <name>/<adjective>-<noun> and an id like r_abc123.

backend.description: Where it runs. aws: ECS Fargate (needs deploy/aws; nothing runs or builds on your machine). docker/podman: this machine.

image.description: Container image. Pin with @sha256:... for exact reproducibility; kiln records the digest either way.

command.description: Overrides the image's command, e.g. ["sh", "-c", "npm test"].

env.description: Plain environment variables. Stored in the run record: never put secrets here.

secrets.description: Secret names only. docker: read from your environment. aws: from SSM /kiln/<stack>/secrets/<NAME>. Values are never stored.

inputs.description: Files/folders (relative to kiln.yaml) copied to /kiln/inputs before the agent starts. "." sends the whole folder (contents at the top, .git and .kiln skipped) and must be the only entry. Up to 512 MB packed.

exclude.description: Glob patterns left out of inputs, matched against names and paths, e.g. [node_modules, "*.log", dist].

repo.description: A git repository checked out at /kiln/src before the command starts, so a stock image (node, python, golang...) can run your project with nothing built locally. The ref is pinned to the exact commit when the run starts; kiln rerun reuses that commit. On aws it is cloned inside the task (big repos never pass through your machine).

ref.description: Branch, tag or full commit SHA. Default: the repo's default branch.

token.description: For private https repos: the NAME of a secret holding a token (aws: SSM /kiln/<stack>/secrets/<NAME>; docker: your environment). Sent as an HTTP header, never stored in the checkout. The agent can read it: use a read-only token.

workdir.description: Folder the command runs in. Default /kiln/src when repo is set, else the image's own.

budget.description: Hard caps. The run is stopped at whichever is reached first. 0 means the default; caps cannot be turned off.

warn_at.description: Fraction of either cap at which a warning event is recorded.

price_per_hour.description: Override the backend's $/hour (e.g. to test caps on docker, which is otherwise free).

cpu.description: vCPUs. aws: rounded up to a valid Fargate size.

spot.description: aws: Fargate Spot, about 70% cheaper, can be interrupted.
